text: DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy 将 WorkBuddy 与 WorkBuddy AI 的模型接入 DSH Web，并复用桌面应用登录。插件注册两个模型提供方，通过本机回环适配器转发请求，并按账号轮换；同时提供账号管理、模型目录与显隐设置、额度和 token 用量面板、侧栏额度卡及每日签到。适合已登录 WorkBuddy、希望在 DSH 对话中选择其模型并查看账号状态的用户。需要本机已登录的 WorkBuddy 桌面应用，不需单独配置 API Key。

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy connects WorkBuddy models to DSH Web, reusing desktop sign-in. It registers providers, routes requests locally, and rotates accounts. The dashboard shows credit, token use and model visibility. A signed-in WorkBuddy app is required; no API key is configured.

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy 的功能「WorkBuddy 模型接入」：在 DSH 模型目录注册 WorkBuddy 与 WorkBuddy AI 提供方，读取实时模型目录，并将模型请求发往本机回环适配器。
DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy 的功能「多账号轮换」：请求从可用账号池中选择账号；限流或额度不足的账号进入冷却，之后可重新参与轮换。
DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy 的功能「额度与用量面板」：按账号累计请求、prompt 与 completion token 等数据，并在侧栏卡片和面板中展示。
DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy 的功能「模型显隐」：在设置页按账号保存模型可见性，更新后刷新模型目录，让选择器遵循当前账号的筛选。
DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy 的功能「每日签到」：支持的产品可按计划检查账号签到状态，也可由用户对指定账号手动签到。

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy README · dsh-workbuddy-connect-functy：> ## ⚠️ 先说风险：上游正在收紧，随时可能用不了
>
> **2026-10-20 起，WorkBuddy 对话网关启用了针对第三方客户端的渠道校验**，本插件（以及所有同类第三方接入）都可能被直接拒绝。
>
> - 典型报错：`400 / code 11128 / Illegal API invocation from an unapproved channel`，中文提示「请求被拦截，请重新发送」「这次调用没通过渠道校验，可能不是官方客户端发出的」。
> - 校验维度在持续增加：已确认的有**系统提示词开头的固定句**（DSH 核心注入的 `You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness.`），以及**请求头格式**（`X-Conversation-*` 系列、`acp-connection-id`、`X-No-*` 的用法）。历史版本已经因为漏掉 `X-Conversation-*` 三件套、发错 `X-No-*` 而各被拦过一次。
> - **本插件是跟着官方客户端做字节级模仿**，属于猫鼠游戏：上游改一次，插件就可能失效一次，直到有人再适配。**没有任何版本能保证长期可用。**
> - **账号风险真实存在**：本轮排查中，一个 CN 账号的 refresh token 被上游吊销（`invalid_grant: User disabled`），另一个被判定「账号存在异常行为，已被限制使用」（`403 / 11140`）。频繁重试、批量轮换、异常调用节奏都可能加速这一判定。
> - 上游 [corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect) 已于 2026-10-20 **停止维护**，明确表示「尊重这一边界，不再继续适配」此类校验，仓库计划 2026-10-22 下线。本仓库曾是这个方向的独立分支，**现已归档停止维护**（见顶部说明），这条路到这里为止。
>
> **请自行评估是否值得用你的账号承担这个风险。** 介意的话，直接用官方 WorkBuddy 客户端。

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy README · dsh-workbuddy-connect-functy：---

这是 [corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect) 的分支，不是上游本体。上游 npm 包仍叫 `dsh-workbuddy-connect`（当前 `0.7.8`，只认 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`）。本仓库发在 **`dsh-workbuddy-connect-functy`**，界面和账号模型都走了另一条线。

国内版 **WorkBuddy** 与国际版 **WorkBuddy AI** 同时支持：装哪个 App 就出现哪个模型分组，两个都装就两组并存，各自用自己的账号与积分。

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy README · 和上游差在哪：两边都有：国内/国际分组、图片输入、推理档位检测、模型显隐、国内企业额度、选择器里的倍率与促销徽章、Windows Electron 发现、按区域识别 effort 拒绝码。

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy README · 和上游差在哪：**请求身份**：chat 送出的是 `WorkBuddy/<v> WorkBuddy/<v> CLI/<v>` 的 UA（**两服都是 `WorkBuddy`，不带 `AI`**——两个官方包的网关代理都这么拼）、`X-IDE-*` 归属头、`X-Agent-Intent: craft` / `X-Agent-Purpose: conversation` / `X-Agent-Type: main` / `x-codebuddy-request: 1` / `X-Private-Data: true`，以及共享同一 traceId 的 `traceparent` + B3 + `X-Trace-ID`。会话头按官方规则分三层生命周期：`X-Conversation-ID` 一次会话稳定、`X-Conversation-Request-ID` 一轮稳定、`X-Conversation-Message-ID` 每请求新；空闲 30 分钟换会话、10 分钟换轮。chat 不带 `Origin`/`Referer`（官方原生客户端也不带），控制台接口仍然带。两服的 chat 头**完全相同**，只有 URL、`X-Domain` 和版本号按区域取；请求体差异也只有国际服补 system 消息、去掉 `reasoning_effort: off` 两条。
DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy README · 展示：对话里直接用 WorkBuddy 模型（输入框显示倍率与推理档位，底栏有用量和额度）： 模型选择器按 WorkBuddy / WorkBuddy AI 分组，带倍率与免费标记： 设置页管账号池、周期额度与模型列表： 勾选要出现在选择器里的模型：

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy README · 功能：- **开箱即用**：装上并启用后，对话里直接选 WorkBuddy 模型。插件复用桌面 App 的登录，账号切换会跟。
- **仪表盘**：侧栏底部一张额度卡，点开中栏看完整面板；设置 → **DSH-WorkBuddy** 管账号、模型、上下文长度和推理档位检测。卡片本身可以关掉。
- **多账号轮换**：同一产品可放多个账号。请求在可用账号之间轮换；被上游限流的会暂时搁置，稍后自动重试。添加方式：扫码、网页令牌、桌面端凭证。
- **额度**：侧栏可显示剩余额度或「已用 / 总量」；国内企业账号走企业计费接口。
- **图片输入**：多数模型支持粘贴或拖入图片。
- **推理档位**：上游声明了的直接显示。没声明的，Web / Desktop 可在选择器里点「推理等级」手动检测（会发少量请求，可能扣积分）。
- **模型显隐**：按登录账号分别保存。隐藏只影响选择器，已有会话不受影响。

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy README · 安装：前置：已安装并登录 WorkBuddy 桌面 App（国际版同理）。核心必须对上，否则 DSH 起不来。

> **⚠️ 此次更新跨度较大，并未经过充分测试，更新后可能出现显示问题以及其他更严重的问题。**
> 升级前建议备份 `~/.dsh`（尤其 `.workbuddy-*.json` 状态文件与 `profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`）。
>
> 本版另有两处**不兼容变化**：entry id 改为 `llm-workbuddy-functy`；locale 命名空间改为
> `settings.workbuddy.functy` / `panel.workbuddy.functy`。与上游 `dsh-workbuddy-connect` 同时安装会
> 因 provider id 冲突导致发消息失败，请只保留一个。

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy README · 支持的 DSH 版本（**只此一条线**）：| 版本 | 是否支持 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `0.2.1-rc.x`（实测 `0.2.1-rc.2`） | ✅ **支持** | 本版按这条线的 kernel 与 `pi-ai 1.1.0` 编译并实测 |
| `0.2.0-rc.x` | ❌ 不支持 | 其 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 基于 `pi-ai ^0.87.1`，与本版锁定的 `1.1.0` 冲突，进程里会同时存在两代 pi-ai，**请求在发出 HTTP 之前就报 `PI_AI_ERROR`** |
| `0.1.7-alpha.x` | ❌ 不支持 | 同上，那一线基于 `pi-ai ^0.85.1` |
| `0.2.1` 之后的 prerelease | ⚠️ 未验证 | peer range 不接受，需要显式改动 |

`peerDependencies` 已收窄到 `^0.2.1-rc.1` 与 `@earendil-works/pi-ai ^1.1.0`，所以在装错的宿主上**包管理器会直接拒绝安装**，而不是装完才发现模型不能用。

2. 选 **添加插件**。

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy README · 命令行：CLI 二进制仍叫 `dsh-workbuddy-connect`（和 provider id 一样没改，避免已装用户的脚本对不上）：

默认国内版；加 `--provider workbuddy-ai` 走国际版。`accounts` 只读。`logout` 只删插件自留副本，不动桌面 App 的登录。

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy README · 已知限制：- 在 macOS 的 Web / Desktop 下验证过（DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`，Node 22+）。Windows 依次探 Local 与 Roaming AppData；WSL 优先读挂载的 Windows 用户目录。用户名不一致时用 `WORKBUDDY_AUTH_FILE` / `WORKBUDDY_AI_AUTH_FILE`。
- 侧栏两个显示偏好要宿主能写设置；状态文档没有对应字段时，设置页不画开关。
- 国际版模型目录来自 App 界面接口，属私有实现，可能失效；届时按「本账号上次成功目录 → 内置目录」降级。
- 国际版企业计费未验证；无凭据时该版模型分组不再显示。
- 依赖 WorkBuddy 客户端接口，App 更新后插件可能要跟。
- **网关的渠道校验是最容易失效的一环**：它按「请求是否像官方客户端」判定，判定维度在增加（系统提示词开头、`X-Conversation-*` 三件套、`acp-connection-id`、`X-No-*` 的用法）。上游改一次，插件就可能整体不可用，直到有人再适配。
- 本插件当前按官方客户端的字节级特征做对齐，**不做任何风控规避**（不改 IP、不伪造设备指纹、不做批量注册）。因此上游若引入新的维度（设备、频率、签名），本插件不会尝试绕过。

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy README · 免责声明：仅供个人学习研究，只驱动使用者自己的账号在本机调用。遵守 WorkBuddy 服务条款；后果自负。与腾讯、WorkBuddy、DeepSeek 均无关联。

**关于封禁与稳定性的明确说明**（不重复上方风险框，只补可操作的部分）：

- 本插件通过模仿官方客户端的请求特征来通过网关校验。这类校验属于**对方单方面随时可变**的机制，本仓库无法承诺任何可用性期限，也不保证你的账号不会因此被限制或封禁。
- 上游自 2026-10-20 起收紧后，社区里已出现账号被限制的实例（含本仓库排查过程中的两个）。**建议只用自己的账号、控制调用频率、不要用于批量或多开场景。**
- 如果出现 `400 / 11128`，先确认是不是上游又换了校验维度，而不是急着反复重试 —— 重试本身可能加速风控判定。把 `requestId` 附在 issue 里比反复试更有用。
- 不提供任何规避风控、批量注册、多账号池规模化使用的支持。

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy README · dsh-workbuddy-connect-functy：> ## ⚠️ Read this first: upstream is tightening, and it can break at any time
>
> **Since 2026-10-20 the WorkBuddy chat gateway enforces channel verification against third-party clients.** This plugin — and every other third-party integration — can be refused outright.
>
> - Typical failure: `400 / code 11128 / Illegal API invocation from an unapproved channel`, surfaced to users as 「请求被拦截，请重新发送」 / 「这次调用没通过渠道校验，可能不是官方客户端发出的」.
> - The checks keep growing. Confirmed so far: the **fixed sentence at the start of the system prompt** (DSH core injects `You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness.`), and the **request-header shape** (`X-Conversation-*`, `acp-connection-id`, how `X-No-*` is used). Earlier releases of this plugin were already refused once for omitting the `X-Conversation-*` trio and once for sending `X-No-*` where the official client never does.
> - **This plugin imitates the official client at the byte level**, which is a cat-and-mouse game: every upstream change can break it until someone adapts again. **No version can promise it keeps working.**

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy README · dsh-workbuddy-connect-functy：---

This is a fork of [corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect), not the upstream project. The upstream npm package is still `dsh-workbuddy-connect` (currently `0.7.8`, DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` only). This repository publishes as **`dsh-workbuddy-connect-functy`**, with a different UI and account model.

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy README · How this fork differs：Both trees have: CN/AI groups, image input, reasoning-effort detection, per-account model visibility, CN enterprise credit, picker rate/promo badges, Windows Electron discovery, per-region effort-rejection codes.

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy README · How this fork differs：**Request identity**: chat sends `WorkBuddy/<v> WorkBuddy/<v> CLI/<v>` as the UA (**`WorkBuddy` twice in both regions, never `AI`** — both shipped apps' gateway proxies compose it that way), the `X-IDE-*` attribution family, `X-Agent-Intent: craft` / `X-Agent-Purpose: conversation` / `X-Agent-Type: main` / `x-codebuddy-request: 1` / `X-Private-Data: true`, and `traceparent` + B3 + `X-Trace-ID` sharing one trace id. The conversation headers follow the official three-tier lifetime: `X-Conversation-ID` stable per conversation, `X-Conversation-Request-ID` stable per turn, `X-Conversation-Message-ID` fresh per request — a new conversation after 30 idle minutes, a new turn after 10. Chat sends no `Origin`/`Referer` (neither does the native client); the console endpoints still do. The two regions' chat headers are **identical**; only the URL, `X-Domain`, and the version are region-scoped, and the only body differences are the international system-message prepend and the removal of `reasoning_effort: off`.

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy README · Features：- **Zero configuration**: after install, pick a WorkBuddy model in chat. The plugin reuses the desktop app's sign-in and follows account switches.
- **Dashboard**: a credit card at the sidebar foot opens the centre-column panel; Settings → **DSH-WorkBuddy** manages accounts, models, context length and reasoning-level detection. The card itself can be switched off.
- **Multi-account rotation**: several accounts per product. Requests rotate across available ones; a rate-limited account is benched and retried later. Add via QR, a pasted token, or the desktop app's own sign-in.
- **Credit**: sidebar can show remaining credit or used/total; CN enterprise accounts use the enterprise billing endpoint.
- **Images**: most models accept paste or drag-and-drop.
- **Reasoning levels**: declared sets show up directly. Undeclared models can be probed from the picker on Web / Desktop (a few requests, may spend credit).
- **Visibility**: saved per signed-in account. Hiding a model only affects the picker; existing chats keep working.
DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy README · Install：Prerequisite: the WorkBuddy desktop app is installed and signed in (same for WorkBuddy AI). A mismatched DSH core fails to start.

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy README · Supported DSH versions (**one line only**)：`peerDependencies` are narrowed to `^0.2.1-rc.1` and `@earendil-works/pi-ai ^1.1.0`, so a wrong host makes the **package manager refuse the install** instead of leaving you with a plugin whose models cannot answer.

**This release (`0.13.17`) supports DSH `0.2.1-rc.x` ONLY** (verified on `0.2.1-rc.2`). **Do not install it on `0.1.7-alpha.x` or `0.2.0-rc.x`** — see below.

> **Do not install npm's `dsh-workbuddy-connect`.** That is the upstream package, a different code line.

**On bans and stability** (the actionable part; the warning box above covers the rest):

DSH WorkBuddy Connect Functy README · Disclaimer：- The plugin passes gateway checks by imitating the official client's request characteristics. Those checks are **theirs to change at any time**, so this repository promises no period of availability and does not guarantee your account will not be restricted or banned.
- Since the upstream tightened on 2026-10-20 there have been real cases of restricted accounts, including two during this repository's own diagnosis. **Use your own account, keep request rates sane, and do not use it for bulk or multi-instance workloads.**
- On a `400 / 11128`, first check whether the upstream changed the check rather than retrying in a loop — retrying can itself accelerate a risk-control decision. A `requestId` in an issue is worth more than repeated attempts.
- No support is offered for evading risk controls, bulk registration, or running large account pools at scale.
